method: Second visual inspection at 16 pixels per point, with 24x digit comparisons for named hypotheses and worn digits. This is the same audit reader, after comparison with v1.

p20_c0_r10.evidence: Final digit has two rounded lobes, with a broken upper-right contour; 8, unlike the upper hook of 6. Underlined double-headed anthropomorphic drawing.

p20_c0_r21.evidence: Initial digit has a curved upper hook and lower loop, 6; final 5 has a flat top. Underlined figure between curved brackets.

p20_c0_r24.evidence: Middle digit has an upper hook and lower loop, 6. Figure with a diagonal extension at its head.

p20_c1_r9.evidence: Middle and final digits each have two lobes; both are 8. Figure with a raised fork-ended arm.

p20_c2_r25.evidence: Middle digit has an upper hook, not a flat top; 6. Underlined oval-bodied drawing with a transverse bar.

p20_c4_r1.evidence: Final lower digit has an upper rounded lobe with an isolated right-side ink fragment and a lower loop, matching 8. The class 86 above has a visibly different hooked 6. Underlined branching stem with diagonal hatch strokes. Resolves the duplicate 506 with the distinct overlapping-oval drawing p21_c7_r5.

p20_c4_r13.evidence: Middle lower digit starts with a rounded upper hook and joins a lower loop. In the side-by-side 24x comparison, p21_c1_r19's 350 has a horizontal top and separate descending bowl. Class 93 drawing has opposed comb bars. The new v3 hypothesis 350 is rejected by these digit pixels.

p20_c4_r15.evidence: Middle lower digit has the curved hook of 6; final digit is 4. Underlined fork on a horizontal bar.

p20_c4_r18.evidence: Class final digit has an upper hook and lower loop, 6. Compound branching stem and double comb. Sequence 95,96,97 supports the pixels.

p20_c5_r12.evidence: Final lower digit has an upper hook and lower loop, 6. A single branching stem with a hatched top.

p20_c5_r21.evidence: Middle lower digit is a curved-hook 6, unlike flat-top 5 on p20_c7_r1's 459. Underlined bent pair of strokes.

p20_c5_r27.evidence: Middle digit has upper hook and lower loop, 6. Final digit has two lobes. Underlined long vertical stroke.

p20_c6_r25.evidence: Final lower digit has two lobes and broken right upper contour, 8. Two stacked arches.

p20_c8_r15.evidence: Final digit has upper and lower rounded lobes, 8. Its upper-right contour differs from the open upper hook of 226 at p20_c8_r17. Curved stroke with terminal forks, flanked by paired ticks.

p20_c9_r19.evidence: Initial and final digits both have upper hooks and lower loops, 6. Underlined angular stem with a leaf-shaped loop.

p21_c0_r1.evidence: Initial digit has a rounded upper hook and lower loop, 6. At 24x it differs from the flat-top 5 of p21_c9_r17's 598. Underlined vertical stroke with two diverging lower branches.

p21_c6_r31.evidence: Final lower digit has a rounded upper hook and lower loop, 6, compared with the flat-top 5 in class 345 directly above. Arched top joins two hanging loops and a central stem; p21_c6_r32's rectangular-top variant reads 262.

p21_c8_r5.evidence: Final continuation check at 24x: initial digit has a rounded upper hook and lower loop, matching the initial 6 of p21_c8_r2 (691). It differs from the horizontal top and left stem of 5 in p20_c3_r18 (579). Circle with slashed inner oval, an outer triangular projection and dashed underline; class 370. The earlier same-reader decision 571 was incorrect and is preserved under continuation-history.
